versions.content: Schema Generator avoids duplicate VariationPoint s if {PartClass} has a subclass (say, SubPartClass ) that is aggregated else- where (say, AnotherWholeClass ) and this other aggregation is also tagged with atpVariation , then SubPartClass would aggregate two variation points. To avoid this, the schema generator (i.e., the metamodel tool) uses a special processing step to clean up such duplicate VariationPoint s.
